text:
maria: Heads up — drafting internal release notes for 1.4.3. Change window Tue 2025-11-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need: announce copy, canary owner, rollback play. Pinged infra for DB migration footnote.

alex: Are we pinning runtimes/models for this one? I vote pin runtime -> 2.1.0 to avoid perf drift.

maria: Yes. We'll pin the serving runtime to 2.1.0 and inference model to open-llm-v3.1. Add lines to RN and to deploy bot config:
```
runtime_pin: 2.1.0
model_tag: open-llm-v3.1
```

jamie: Draft internal blurb: "Rolling out 1.4.3 — runtime pinned to 2.1.0, fix to routing for short sequences; canary 10% for 30m; rollback to 1.4.2 if errors." Thoughts?

khalid: Add metrics to watch: p99 latency, token_error_rate, queue_length, and deploybot health. Changelog link: https://redwood.example/changelog/1.4.3

sre-oncall: Runbook snippet to include:
`deployctl rollback --release=1.4.3 --reason=canary-failure`
If canary errors >5% for 10m escalate to oncall.
I'll standby during the window.

deploybot: Scheduled canary for release 1.4.3 at Tue 02:05 UTC. Canary traffic: 10% -> 50% over 30m. Canary owner: @alex.

alex: I'll take canary. I'll watch traces + eval set conv-regressions. DM if you need access to the dashboard.

maria: Copy tweak: replace "minor routing fix" with "fix to smart routing for short seqs (reduces cold-starts)" — Jamie can you update?

jamie: Updated RN snippet: "Fix: smart routing for short-sequence requests to avoid cold-start spikes. Pin runtime 2.1.0. Canary 10% for 30m. Rollback: automatic to 1.4.2 on >5% errors."

khalid: Migration footnote: "DB migration is online; background index build expected ~40m. Watch infra-console > Migrations." Add note to RN and internal announce.

deploybot: Canary started at Tue 02:06 UTC. group=cb-1768005432-c1 traffic=10%.

sre-oncall: Canary healthy at 02:20 UTC. No spike in errors or p99. :thumbsup:

maria: OK — plan to post internal announce at 02:40 UTC if canary stays green. Draft for #eng-releases:
"Heads up: 1.4.3 rolling out to hosted. Fixes smart routing for short requests; runtime pinned to 2.1.0. Canary healthy — no action required. See changelog: <https://redwood.example/changelog/1.4.3>. Ops: runbook pinned."

alex: LGTM. Suggest adding "If you see increased latency on embeddings, revert to 1.4.2." Quick flag for support.

jamie: Final RN published: https://redwood.example/internal/1.4.3-rn

maria: I'll pin the RN and schedule the internal post for 02:40 UTC after the canary check. Thanks all.

deploybot: Canary success. Ramping to 50% at Tue 02:36 UTC.

deploybot: Canary promoted to production at 03:10 UTC. Release 1.4.3 live. audit_id=audit-1768005432. To rollback: `deployctl rollback --release=1.4.3`.

sre-oncall: Noted. Oncall monitoring next 60m. Ping if anything unusual.

maria: Closing thread — will update the incident channel if any rollback occurs. :lock_with_ink_pen:
